scope: Existing customer-free catalog resources; current action.configure for immutable definition versions and resource.read for expansion
references: Every component pins an authentic immutable material or BOM ID/version/digest. Job plans preserve all nested BOM references and material versions
quantities: Positive decimal strings with at most six decimal places, reduced exact BigInt rational arithmetic, then exact positive integer base-unit leaves. Fractional base units reject
yield: Positive integer numerator/denominator, numerator <= denominator, denominator <= 1000000. Each nested level scales component quantities by required good output divided by declared output times yield
scrap: Root gross output is planned good divided by root yield; declared expected scrap is gross less planned good. Nested losses are already included in expanded leaf requirements
costs: Frozen material cost per base unit, exact quantity-weighted minor-unit sum, and exact cost allocation per root gross-output unit; incompatible currencies or fractional allocation reject
validation: more than 16 nested levels or 256 expansion nodes
conflicting versions for the same leaf variant
fractional base quantities or unsupported cost allocation
independent_fixture: Four good finished units require five gross units, 2500 g cotton and ten buttons; total component cost 2600 minor units
targeted_fault: Actual isolated nested batch calculation omits yield loss; independent 2500 g cotton requirement detects the discrepancy
privacy_restore: Customer-free business definitions use recursive explicit allowlists. Definitions are data, not production authority; every restored production review/grant is revoked
remaining_limits: No arbitrary unit conversions, density inference, implicit component substitution or rounding
Material book costs are declared fixture values, not inferred supplier payments
